Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the pass mark, the target score, the fail rate you accept, the share of jobs you want to inspect and the working days to fix a finding.

Check Checklist Items: they are the tasks of each service room by room, with the minutes each takes and the critical ones marked. A labour hour is one cleaner working for one hour and a crew is the cleaners who work together on a job.
Record every inspection on Inspections: the items checked and failed and the weak area. The pass flag, the points lost and the phones fill in by themselves.
Write the checklist of each job on Checklist Results and the photo sets on Photo Checks; the completion and the photo check fill in by themselves.
Open a row on Corrective Actions for every failed inspection: the person, the due date and the day it was done. A re-clean is a free return visit to fix a problem; record it on Re-clean Jobs.
Read Quality by Crew and Month and Failed Items by Area to see which crew and which part of the home need coaching, then write the session on Coaching Notes.
Plan Spot-check Plan with the Spot-check Sample calculator, keep Special Instructions for each client and settle Damage and Breakage and Lost and Found items quickly.
Call clients on Satisfaction Calls: a score of 3 or less shows as a call back to make.

Use the 14 calculators when you plan: score, pass mark, spot checks, re-clean cost, cost of poor quality, checklist time, crew ranking, coaching need, photo review, critical items, failure rate, fix-by date, bonus pool and a what-if grid.
Read the Quality Dashboard and Charts every week: inspections, scores, weak areas, re-cleans, actions, damage and satisfaction.
Insurance, liability and safety rules differ by place: check your own local rules before you use any sample wording.

Supply items with the reorder quantity
The 24 chemicals, cloths, disposables, protective gear and tools you buy, with the pack, the unit cost, the reorder point and the par level; the quantity to reorder fills in from the stock on hand.
Stock on hand with value, days of cover and reorder flag
One row per supply item with the quantity on hand against the reorder point and the par level; the stock value, the weekly use, the days of cover and the reorder flag fill in by themselves.
Purchases with the price against the item average
One row per purchase of supplies with the quantity, the unit cost, the amount, the supplier and how it was paid; the price against the average you paid for the item fills in by itself.
Equipment with age and days to service
The 16 machines and tools with the crew, the cost, the life in months and the service interval; the age, the days to the next service, the service check and the life check fill in by themselves.
Equipment services with cost per downtime day
One row per service or repair of a machine with the kind, the cost, who did it and the days it was out of use; the cost per downtime day fills in by itself.
Jobs with supplies and travel cost per job
Every job of the last 30 days and older ones with the price and the labour, supplies and travel cost; the shares of the price, the cost of the job and a target check fill in by themselves.
Service months with supplies cost per job
One row per service and month with the jobs, revenue, costs, labour hours and profit; the supplies cost per job, the total cost per job and the supplies cost per labour hour fill in by themselves.
Areas with travel time and surcharge
The four areas, each in three zones, with the minutes a trip takes and the surcharge you add to the price of a visit; the travel cost tools use these minutes.
Stock counts with the difference and its value
One row per item counted with the count you expected from the books and who counted; the difference, its value and the match check fill in by themselves.
Price history with the change from last month
One row per item and month with the unit cost and the supplier; the change from the month before and the price check fill in by themselves, so a supplier price rise shows at once.
Supplier quotes with the saving against the current price
One row per quote from a supplier for an item with the pack, the price and the day the quote ends; the current price, the saving and the quote check fill in by themselves.
Suppliers with lead time and payment terms
The four suppliers by size of order with the days a delivery takes and the days you have to pay; the reorder list and the supplier messages use them.
Van stock with the shortfall against the standard load
One row per crew and item with the quantity on the van, the standard load and the day it was checked; the shortfall and the van check fill in by themselves.
One row per item with the hazard note, the storage, what never to mix it with and the check day; the days since the check and the review check fill in. Check your own local rules too.
Waste and spills with their cost
One row per spill, expired pack or lost item with the quantity, the cause and who reported it; the cost fills in from the unit cost of the item.
Travel cost by area and month
One row per area and month with the jobs, the minutes on the road and the travel cost; the cost per job and the minutes per job fill in by themselves.
Equipment replacement plan with months left
One row per machine with the month you plan to replace it, the expected cost and the reason; the months left and the plan check fill in by themselves.
Cost per job by service and size band
One row per service and size band with the average supplies, travel and labour cost and the price; the cost of the job, the profit and the margin fill in by themselves.
Reorder list with days waiting and delivery check
One row per order with the quantity, the supplier, the day you need it, the day it was ordered and the day it arrived; the days waiting and the delivery check fill in by themselves.
